headline: New Zealand Work Visa for Australians 2026: What You Actually Need
metaDescription: Australians don't need a NZ work visa in 2026: the free Resident Visa on arrival covers indefinite work rights. PR holder rules, the subclass 444 myth and AEWV explained.

sections.content:
Here is the key fact most guides bury: Australian citizens do not need a work visa for New Zealand at all. Under the Trans-Tasman Travel Arrangement, Australians arriving in New Zealand are granted an Australian Resident Visa at the border, which allows them to live, work and study indefinitely.

The visa is free and cannot be applied for before travel – you must arrive first with a valid Australian passport and meet New Zealand's character requirements, declared on the arrival card. For most Australians, working in New Zealand is simply a matter of booking a flight.
sections.title: The headline fact: no visa needed for Australian citizens

sections.content:
Australian permanent residents are also covered, but with one extra step: unlike citizens, they must obtain an NZeTA before travelling to New Zealand. Australian temporary residents are specifically excluded from the arrangement and need a standard visa.

A common point of confusion is the Special Category Visa subclass 444. That visa works in the reverse direction – it is granted to New Zealand citizens entering Australia, giving automatic, free, indefinite stay with full work rights. It has nothing to do with Australians travelling to New Zealand.
sections.title: Permanent residents, and the subclass 444 confusion

sections.content:
For everyone else, the main route is the Accredited Employer Work Visa. It requires a full-time job offer of at least 30 hours per week from an INZ-accredited employer with an approved Job Check. Fees are roughly NZD 750 to 1,540 and processing typically takes 4 to 12 weeks.

The visa lasts up to 5 years for higher-skilled occupations and 3 years for lower-skilled ones. 2026 changes removed the fixed median-wage requirement – pay must now match the market rate for the role – and cut the work-experience requirement from 3 years to 2.
sections.title: The AEWV route for non-Australians in 2026

sections.content:
Australians enjoy the simplest trans-Tasman mobility of any nationality pair in the world, and the arrangement shows no sign of changing. If you are an Australian citizen, the practical steps are minimal: valid passport, meet character requirements, and arrange work after arrival or beforehand as you prefer.

One caveat: the Australian Resident Visa is a New Zealand visa, so it does not help you work anywhere else, and long absences can affect related entitlements. For career planning, New Zealand's smaller job market pays less than Australia's in many fields, so compare salaries before committing to the move.
